example.title: Hotel tower on East Ocean Boulevard (right of the photo; Renaissance Long Beach, 1983)
example.place: Long Beach, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1983 fourteen-storey hotel tower: tan concrete with rounded corners and continuous horizontal balcony bands, a curved glass lobby pavilion at the base on a palm-lined boulevard, office towers behind. One photo (the right-hand building). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
